tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), the authority of the Secretary to carry out this subchapter terminates on the date that is 10 years after December 22, 2006.

tree.heading: Exception
tree.text: The termination of authority under subsection (a) shall have no effect on—

children.text: any loans guaranteed by the United States under this subchapter; or
the administration of any loan guaranteed under this subchapter before the effective date of the termination of authority.
